info.name: Kanmon Public V2 Bank Accounts API

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma delimited list of Kanmon’s unique IDs for bank accounts.

params.name: platformBankAccountIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of your platform’s unique IDs for bank accounts.

params.name: platformBusinessIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of your platform’s unique business IDs for bannk accounts.

params.name: businessIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of your Kanmon’s unique business IDs for bannk accounts.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of records to skip when performing pagination. Defaults to `0`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of records to limit when performing pagination. Defaults to `100`, which is the max.

params.name: createdAtStart
params.description: Filter for records where `createdAt` is greater than or equal to this value. ISO 8601 format.

params.name: createdAtEnd
params.description: Filter for records where `createdAt` is less than or equal to this value. ISO 8601 format.

items.docs: Please contact Kanmon to enable access to bank account APIs.

We only support creating disbursement checking accounts at the moment. Each business can only have one disbursement checking account.
      Please contact Kanmon to enable access to bank account APIs.

params.name: id
params.description: Either the Kanmon bank account UUID or your platform’s bank account ID, depending on `idType`.

params.name: idType
params.description: Which ID type to query the bank account by. Defaults to `KANMON`. Use `PLATFORM` if you want to query by your platform’s ID.
